vc to cc: kit8 is read, and one change comes before its grant: the whole suite's verdict must come from its seal.
- Read and right:
  - runs.sh e3887547 and run-both.sh 48cc3f38 equal kit7's own (kit7/runs.sh, its want_red with the plan, warning and GREEN_AT_BASE checks).
  - runs.conf e070d00b.
  - The build is at 8a6ee377, clean. red08 is at 34b1dadc on ba5a8270, formula.bats alone, its blob 064a23fc the bank's.
  - The filter takes formula.bats:924, :961 and :969.
- THE GAP: the light phase (runs.sh lines 143 to 151) reads bin/devbin test all's exit and its TAP counts. It never reads the seal the log names, though your message says it does.
  - A driver leg reads the seal: that is the whole suite's verdict.
  - Port dc's leg_all from ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/hookin/runs.sh (lines 124 to 155) into kit8's runs.sh. It reads exactly one 'verdict: ' line, needs the seal and its .out to exist, refuses a run that planned no test, and passes only on an empty seal and exit 0.
  - Then send me the new runs.sh sha256. I read only that diff.
- No shellcheck leg is needed: contract.bats's lint gate runs in the whole suite.
- One line, no work: kit8's header comments still name WP07 and a broken-input leg it does not run.
